info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Evaluation Reviews API
info.description: The Employee Evaluation Reviews API facilitates the submission of performance reviews for employees within the human resource management system. Organizations can utilize this endpoint to collect and organize feedback from evaluators, ensuring comprehensive assessments of employee performance. This API is particularly useful for HR professionals and managers who need to streamline the review process and capture valuable insights into employee development. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their evaluation workflows and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

post.summary: Submit a review for employee evaluation.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit a performance review for a specific employee evaluation. Be sure to include all necessary details in the request body to successfully process the review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new review for the specified employee (EMP-900045) as part of the employee evaluation process within the human resource management system. It must include all required fields as defined in the schema.
